The asymptotic gap follows with an \(O(d^{-1})\) remainder and a CLT with uniform integrability. Independent exact-rational density integrations match the formula for dimensions 2 through 10, with 23 moment and 37 further exact finite checks; finite tests do not replace universal proofs.
